349224: Zenos is a young healer who's been kicked out of the party of adventurers for being deemed useless. He now runs a secret clinic in the slums as he doesn't have a healer's license. Having never received formal training, he is unaware of the magnitude of his power.
349225: Lilly is a young elf girl who was saved from the brink of death by Zenos. She decides to help Zenos and moves in with him at the clinic.
349226: Carmilla is a wraith who reigns over the undead, yet her true nature remains a mystery. She lives on the second floor of the clinic and enjoys all the chaos that befalls Zenos.
355713: Krishna is the Vice-Commander of the Royal Guard. She performs her responsibilities with a will as strong as iron, making sure the slums remain safe.
355714: Zonde is the younger brother of Zophia, the leader of the lizardman.
